# IUB Event & Club Management System

> Campus event and club management platform for Independent University, Bangladesh. Students discover events and clubs, register (with waitlists and QR check-in) and apply for memberships; coordinators, club admins and a super admin manage them. Access is restricted to @iub.edu.bd accounts.

## Public pages

- [Landing](https://iub-event-management.web.app/): overview of the platform
- [Sign in](https://iub-event-management.web.app/login): email/password or Google (@iub.edu.bd only)
- [Register](https://iub-event-management.web.app/register): create a student profile

## Documentation

- [Source code and README](https://github.com/tareque0889/IUB_Event_Management): architecture, roles, performance notes, threat model and ADRs

## Optional

- All other routes require authentication and are not intended for indexing.
